title: 환경정책기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Management of Municipal and County Spatial Environmental Information)
① Spatial environmental information (hereinafter referred to as "municipal and county spatial environmental information") as defined in Article 19(5) and Article 9(2)(2) of the Act shall include the following items: <amended as of 2025.10.1>
1. Information on environmental conditions in various fields, such as water, air, and natural ecosystems, collected and produced by the mayor or county executive.
2. Other information on environmental conditions as determined and promulgated by the Minister of Climate and Energy.
② In addition to the items specified in Article 1, the Minister of Climate and Energy shall determine any other matters necessary for the management of municipal and county spatial environmental information. <amended as of 2025.10.1>
